strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime lets an explicit headless continuation cross the failed-verifier stop boundary into recovery task admission.
Headless recovery admission records bounded continuation decision and task admission evidence without raw prompts, provider responses, files, commands, paths, or environment values.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting persistent_structured_ledger and controlled verification recovery.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can admit or replay one verification recovery task from failed verifier-gate evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing headless routes stop at start_verification_recovery_explicitly, while direct task.start recovery admission requires caller-owned RPC switching.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless run control remains stuck at failed verifier boundaries and external schedulers must translate route metadata into recovery task admission.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M16.1/M16.2 handled post-apply verification retry admission/execution and M17.1/M17.2 handled run-session checkpoint/drive control; M18.1 handles the earlier failed-verifier to recovery-task admission boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once method is extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Returned route metadata is tied to actual recovery task admission and existing bounded task handles.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A valid current headless continuation mutates runtime task state by creating or replaying one verification recovery task without running it.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Moves Brownie toward replay-safe drive -> recover -> repair -> apply -> verify progression without caller-owned route switching.
answers.milestone_progress: Establishes the first M18 recovery-loop control vertical slice after M17 run-control closeout.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded verification_recovery_source evidence with explicit recovery authorization
current aggregate progress fingerprint and sequence are checked before recovery task creation
valid source failure evidence creates or replays exactly one verification recovery task
the admitted recovery task is not run and the response routes to run_recovery_task_explicitly
replaying the same continuation_id returns the same recovery task handles without duplicate TaskStarted, HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded, or TaskRunning evidence
stale progress or stale source failure fingerprints fail before task creation
existing direct task.start recovery admission, generic headless.continue_once, M16 retry admission/run, and M17 run advance/drive behavior remain compatible
no new RPC, scheduler, background worker, automatic recovery execution, automatic apply, provider expansion, shell/git/network/service expansion, VSIX policy, or raw data exposure is introduced
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M18.1 merge, consider a bounded M18.2 phase that runs one already-admitted verification recovery task to the repair proposal boundary without automatic apply, verifier retry, scheduler, or wrapper-only output.
